paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum sawm-le-khatna, akha thumna, huai kha ani khat ni in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
heading: Aigupta, Sidar Sing Toh Tehpih Ahi

paite: "Mihing tapa, Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh leh akhua leh amite kiang ah gen inla: Na thupina ah kua toh na kibang a ahia?
"Ngai in, Assuria tuh Lebanon a sidar ahi a, hiang kilawm leh bawkpha, lim sah, sang kilawm, mei lak ah adawn a-om hi.
Tui in ahon vak a, tui thuk in akhangsak hulhul, aphuhna luite'n aluan kual ua, gam sing chih vakna ding in aluangsak hi.
Huchi in gam sing teng zou in asang tuan a; tuite akidaih zoh ziak in akungpite khanglian in, ahiangte asau ua amengkhesak hi.
Ahiang ah tungleng vasate'n bu abawl ua; ahiang nuai ah sa chiteng in nou anei ua; alimnuai ah nam thupi teng ateng uhi.
Huchi in athupina ah akilawm a, ahiangte sauna bang zel in; azungte lah tui tampite kiang ah a-om ngal a,
Pathian huan a sidar singte'n aphazou kei ua; abawk, meilah sing in adem zou kei a; ahiang sesing in aphazou sam kei; akilawmna ah Pathian huan a sing abang zou kei hi.
Ahiang tamsak in ka bawlhoih a, Pathian huan a Eden sing teng in ahaza uhi," chi in.
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Ahong san mahmah a, meipi lak a adawn alen a, alungtang a asandan akisaktheihpih ziak in,
namte lak ah mihattak khut ah ka mansak ding a; athulimlouhdan bang in agawt ding a, ka delhkhe ding.

Huchi in gamdangmi, namte lak a kihtakhuai mahmahte'n aphuk ding ua, anuse ding uh; tangte, phaizangte ah ahiangte ake lemlum ding a, huai gam tuiluanna phaizang tengteng ah ahiangte akitan lemlum ding; leitung a mi tengteng alimnuai a kipan apawtkhe ding ua, amah apaisan ding uh.
Asiatna ah tungleng vasa tengteng ateng ding ua, abawk tung ah gamsate a-om ding uh.

Hiai bel tui a vak sing tengteng akisansak louh ua, adawn uh meipi kal a lengsak lou a, tui a vak sing in asandan uh asuan samlouhna ding uh ahi; lei mun nuainungpen a kokhuk a paisukta, mihing tate lak ah pai ding in, sihna a matsak ahi vekta ngal ua."

Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Sheol a apaisuk ni in amah ka sunsak a, luitui thuktakte ka khawlsak a; huai ah tui tampi let dingte ka daltan a; Lebanon amah ka sunsak lai a; gam sing tengteng amah ziak in agim khin uhi.

Namte leng apuk ging ah ka lingsak a, kokhuk a paisuksate kiang a Sheol a ka paihkhiak ni in; Eden sing tengteng, Lebanon sing hoih tata, tui a vak tengteng lei nuainungpen ah lungmuang in a-omta uhi.
Namsau a thahte kiang ah Sheol ah apaisuk ua; ahi, namte lak a, alimnuai a tengte leh namte lak a akizoppihte toh hankhuk atungsuk uhi."

"Thupina leh letna ah Eden singte lak a kua ahia nang bang om? Himahleh Eden singte toh lei mun nuainungpen ah paihkhiak na hi ding; namsau a thah, zeksumlouhte lak ah na lum ding hi. Hiai bel Pharaoh leh akhua-le-tuite ahi uh," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
